sourceProducts.description:
2026 Topps NOW Road to Opening Day kicks off the 2026 MLB season with a checklist featuring 300 players across the League and exclusive Spring Training photography.

On-card Autographs:

/99 Green Foil

/50 Gold Foil

/25 Orange Foil

/10 Black Foil

/5 Red Foil

1/1 FoilFractor

On-card Dual Autographs

/5 Red Foil

1/1 FoilFractor

Exclusive Base Parallel (1 per box)

/26 Gold Foil

All sales are final. Art subject to change. Not responsible for typographical/printer errors.

sourceProducts.overview:
Brand new for 2026 – MLB Topps NOW® Road To Opening Day – Autograph Collector’s Box!

This box features three 8-card packs – with a guaranteed gold foil parallel numbered to 26 and on-card autograph numbered to 99 or less!

Making their Road To Opening Day debut are on-card dual autographs – highlighting teammates and star pairings from across Major League Baseball. Look for these rare autograph inserts numbered to five or less!

The processing time for this item begins after the sale clock expires. If you choose an upgraded shipping method, it will only expedite the shipping time, not the processing time.
